name: a-ghost-tile-on-a-new-grid-line-pushes-the-rows-down
description: A real cgevent drag from a tab row, up over the space name, to the slot after the fourth favourite. That slot starts a second grid line. The pinned grid is absolute and a hidden room grid in the pane holds its place, so the room must grow too, or the ghost tile covers the space name. On the way the pointer crosses the space name, the pin target: it must show a ghost row under the name, and no dashed ring. Coordinates come from the DOM, plus the 30px the window sits below the screen top.

actions.expression: (() => { const tiles = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dropzone="favorites"] .fav').length; const rows = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)').querySelectorAll('[data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow').length; return tiles + ' tiles, ' + rows + ' rows'; })()

(() => { const b = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)').querySelector('[data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round((b.left + b.right) / 2) + ',' + Math.round((b.top + b.bottom) / 2 + 30); })()

(() => { const tiles = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dropzone="favorites"] .fav'); const b = tiles[3].getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round((b.left + b.right) / 2 + 10) + ',' + Math.round((b.top + b.bottom) / 2 + 30); })()

(() => { window.__ev = []; for (const t of ['dragstart','dragover','drop','dragend']) { document.addEventListener(t, () => { if (window.__ev[window.__ev.length-1] !== t) { window.__ev.push(t); } }, true); } const orig = chrome.send.bind(chrome); window.__cs = []; chrome.send = (name, args) => { if (name === 'sidebarRowFavorited') { window.__cs.push([name, args]); } return orig(name, args); }; const name = () => document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)').querySelector('.wsname'); const base = name().getBoundingClientRect().top; window.__shift = 0; window.__name = 'none'; window.__ring = 'noring'; document.addEventListener('dragover', () => requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (window.__ev.includes('drop')) { return; } window.__shift = Math.max(window.__shift, Math.round(name().getBoundingClientRect().top - base)); if (name().nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('rowghost')) { window.__name = 'nameghost'; } if (document.querySelector('.dropinto')) { window.__ring = 'ring'; } }), true); return 'spying'; })()

assertions.desc: gates the drag: one full grid line and one row
the drag reached drop and dragend
THE MEASUREMENT: the ghost tile on a new grid line pushed the space name down by a tile line
over the space name a ghost row stood under it
no dashed ring on the grid or the space name
the drop asked for the slot after the fourth tile
and the new tile is fifth
